Analyse complex integration flows, including invoicing and article data flows.

Documented experience working in IT projects, including coordination or supporting responsibilities.
Previous experience working with SAP environments.
Ability to understand business requirements and operational processes.
Understanding of system integrations and their impact on end-to-end business workflows.
Fluency in written and spoken English.

Experience in the pharmaceutical, healthcare, production, or logistics industries.
Knowledge of ISF, ISAK, or qsoft systems.

Swedish and/or Finnish language skills.
Valid driving licence and access to a personal vehicle.

Department of Biosystems and Technology
Third-cycle subject area: Agricultural Science
PhD Project: Sustainability Assessment of Agroecological Farming Systems
Description of the doctoral project
The PhD project is a collaboration between the Animal Centred Environments group and the Horticultural and Agroecological Systems (HAS) subject area within the Department. The doctoral research will focus on sustainability assessment of agroecological livestock farming systems, drawing on expertise across both groups and involving collaboration with researchers, farmers and other stakeholders across Europe and Africa through ALASTRA and STRONG MCSA.
About the position
How can sustainability assessment support the transition to more resilient and sustainable farming systems? This PhD project will investigate how multi-criteria approaches can capture the environmental, economic and social performance of agroecological farming systems, identify synergies and trade-offs, and support decisions by farmers and other agricultural stakeholders.
The doctoral student will work primarily within ALASTRA (Agroecology Living Labs in Africa: Redefining the Role of Animals in Food Systems for Climate Action and Sustainability), an EU-funded Horizon Europe project. ALASTRA brings together researchers, farmers and other stakeholders to co-design and evaluate agroecological livestock farming practices through living labs in Kenya, Tanzania, Tunisia and Zambia. SLU leads the development of the holistic assessment framework, including the selection of indicators and the design of sampling and data collection protocols.
The doctoral student will contribute to developing, adapting and evaluating this framework. The research will draw on approaches such as the Global Farm Metric and established agroecological assessment tools, including OASISm the PG tool and TAPE.
The doctoral student will also contribute to STRONG MCSA, an EU-funded Erasmus+ project that strengthens agricultural stakeholders’ capacity to use multi-criteria sustainability assessment (MCSA). These activities will provide a complementary foundation for the doctoral research in ALASTRA.
The doctoral project will combine literature-based research, development and evaluation of assessment methods, quantitative and qualitative data analysis, and engagement with farmers, advisors and researchers. The student will collaborate with partners in Europe and Africa, contribute to project workshops and scientific publications, and communicate findings to academic and practitioner audiences. International visits and participation in project activities may form part of the doctoral studies.
Requirements
To meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).
The following specific entry requirements apply: For the subject of agricultural science, the applicant must have the equivalent knowledge to a minimum of 90 credits in relevant subject areas. This must include a degree project, and at least 30 credits must be at the advanced level.
You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.
Your profile
Required qualifications
A Master’s degree (or equivalent) in Agroecology, Agricultural Science, Environmental Science, Sustainability Science, or a related field
A good understanding of agricultural systems, agroecology and sustainability challenges
Experience in research methods and quantitative data analysis, demonstrated through a degree project or equivalent work
Excellent communication skills in English, both written and spoken
Ability to work independently and collaboratively within an international, multidisciplinary team

Desirable qualifications
Knowledge or experience of Multi Criteria Sustainability Assessment (MCSA), Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), indicator development or farm assessment tools
Experience with literature reviews and the comparative analysis of methods or tools
Experience with statistical analysis and software such as R, or with qualitative research methods
Knowledge of livestock farming, grazing systems, soil health or agroecological transitions
Experience collaborating with farmers, advisors or other agricultural stakeholders, including participatory research or workshops
Experience working in African agricultural contexts or other international research settings
Interest or experience in developing training resources and communicating research to practitioners
Good communication skills in Swedish or another Scandinavian language
A valid car driver’s licence recognized in Sweden

About us
At the Department of Biosystems and Technology, we explore interactions between soil, plants, animals, the environment, climate, and humans in systems for sustainable food production and renewable raw materials.
More information about the department on https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/biosystems-technology/
Read more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee on https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/ 
Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on http://www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/

jobs.occupation: Product Owner and Product Area Coach
jobs.description:
Do you combine strategic product ownership with a passion for developing teams and ways of working? In this position, you shape the direction of our automation platforms while helping strengthen agile product management across Engineering Platforms. 
About the job 
This position combines two areas of responsibility - Product Owner for Productivity Platforms & Advisory and Product Area Coach within Engineering Platforms. You set the direction for Microsoft Power Platform, UiPath and related advisory services, ensuring scalable and well-governed solutions that create business value. At the same time, you coach leaders, Product Owners and teams to strengthen agile ways of working, self-organization and delivery. You report to the Product Area Manager, Engineering Platforms. 
Job responsibilities 
Own and develop the product vision, strategy, roadmap and backlog, balancing business value, risk, cost and technical dependencies. 
Drive service governance, delivery quality and lifecycle management across Power Platform, UiPath and related services. 
Manage product costs, investment decisions and external delivery partners, following up on scope, quality, timelines and outcomes. 
Work closely with business areas and key stakeholders to understand and challenge needs, prioritize effectively and turn demand into valuable services. 
Coach Product Area leadership, Product Owners and Team Coaches to strengthen agile maturity, product management and self-organizing teams. 
Facilitate key forums and planning activities, support clear objectives and priorities, and enable collaboration across Engineering Platforms and Group IT. 

Location  
This position is based in Stockholm or Sandviken. Travel between the two locations is required, normally around two to four days per month, with occasional additional business travel. 
Your profile 
We’re looking for an experienced product professional who understands how to turn strategy and business needs into clear priorities and high-quality IT services. You bring several years of relevant experience as a Product Owner, Product Manager, or in a similar position within IT service delivery, together with experience of low-code or automation platforms in a larger organization. 
Your background includes: 
Experience in product ownership, including vision, roadmap, backlog, prioritization, and lifecycle management. 
Understanding of Microsoft Power Platform, particularly Power Automate and Power Apps, as well as UiPath and comparable automation platforms. 
Experience managing senior stakeholders, governance forums, and external delivery partners. 
Experience coaching leaders, Product Owners and teams in agile ways of working. 
Professional English communication skills, both written and spoken. 
A relevant university degree in IT, engineering, business or a related area, or equivalent relevant work experience. 

Knowledge of ITIL and certifications in agile product ownership or product management, such as PSPO or SAFe PO/PM, are considered an advantage, as is Swedish language proficiency. 
You’re comfortable setting direction, making decisions, and creating momentum. A collaborative and structured approach helps you navigate different interests, while your commercial mindset and clear communication enable you to challenge priorities constructively and keep business value in focus. 
The team 
Productivity Platforms & Advisory is becoming part of Engineering Platforms alongside Cloud, Developer Experience, Integration and Data Platform. Collaboration also spans Product Owners, Team Coaches, architects, business area representatives and other teams across Engineering Platforms.  
Our culture
Our role is clear – through every action, every day, we make the shift and advance the world through engineering. We believe in an inclusive, equal and open-minded culture, and we nurture our diversities to form a solid foundation for achieving great results. Add fair and rewarding benefits, as well as many different career options.  Are you intrigued? Visit our website, LinkedIn or Facebook page to get to know us further.

Sandvik is a global, industrial technology group providing solutions that enhance productivity, profitability and sustainability for the manufacturing, mining and infrastructure industries. RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. Over 1200 clinics in more than 54 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe, Asia and Australia & New Zealand. Today we are more than 485 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. RaySearch Laboratories is looking for an HL7 Integration Engineer to join our Service department. In this role, you will work with healthcare customers to integrate RayCare with hospital information systems and other third-party systems.
You will be the main point of contact between the customer and RaySearch for HL7 integration projects, combining technical integration work with customer communication and project coordination.
We are flexible regarding the location of this position, as long as you are based in Europe. Priority will be given to candidates based in Sweden, France, Spain, the UK, Belgium, the Netherlands and Germany. 
About the job
As an HL7 Integration Engineer, you will support customers throughout the integration process, from understanding their technical environment and requirements to specifying, testing, and validating interfaces.
The role involves close collaboration with customers as well as technical teams within RaySearch. You will work hands-on with HL7 messaging, troubleshoot integration issues, document solutions, and contribute to the planning and delivery of integration projects.
An important part of the role is understanding what the customer needs, identifying what is technically feasible, and translating this into clear specifications, deliverables, and estimates.
You will
Collaborate with customers and our technical teams to provide integration support for RayCare.
Develop integration specifications and workflows for HL7 messaging.
Test and validate HL7 interfaces with different hospital information systems.
Troubleshoot and resolve integration issues involving third-party systems.
Participate in project planning, implementation, and documentation.
Gather technical requirements from customers and translate them into clear integration specifications.
Contribute to estimates, quotations, and statements of work for integration projects.
Stay up to date with relevant standards and technologies within healthcare IT and HL7.
Share your knowledge and experience within the Service team.

Your profile
We are looking for someone with practical experience of healthcare system integrations who is comfortable working directly with customers.
To succeed in the role, we believe you have:
Practical experience working with HL7 v2 messaging.
Knowledge of FHIR and healthcare messaging and data exchange.
Basic programming or scripting skills, preferably in JavaScript or a similar language.
At least one year of relevant experience with healthcare integrations, either within a hospital IT/integration department or at a medical technology or healthcare software company. Relevant experience may also come from a clinical environment where you have worked with system integrations.
Professional proficiency in English.
The ability to communicate technical information clearly to both customers and internal stakeholders.

It is meritorious if you have:
Further experience with FHIR and an understanding of its role in modern healthcare interoperability.
Experience with integration engines such as Mirth Connect (NextGen Connect).
Knowledge of good development practices, including documentation, version control, and working in a controlled development environment.
Experience from an oncology environment, for example radiotherapy or chemotherapy.
Previous experience in customer-facing technical support or consulting.
Experience gathering customer requirements and translating them into technical scope and deliverables.
Experience preparing estimates, quotations, or statements of work, including assessing technical feasibility and estimating the effort required for an integration.
A command of other languages than English

Our Culture 
Culture at RaySeach is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems - no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care. 
Our Offer 
At RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package.
